title: PadiPolicyConfig
description: Anti-pattern policy configuration for Padi AI Coding Harness

anti_patterns.name: no_raw_crypto_calls
anti_patterns.reason: Direct calls to `:crypto.hash/2` are insecure without proper configuration. Use the CryptoWrapper library which handles key derivation and algorithm selection securely.

anti_patterns.name: no_hardcoded_secrets
anti_patterns.reason: Hardcoded secrets in source code are a major security vulnerability. They will be exposed in version control.
anti_patterns.recommendation: Use Application.get_env/3 or runtime configuration for secrets.

anti_patterns.name: no_sql_string_concatenation
anti_patterns.reason: String concatenation in SQL queries leads to SQL injection vulnerabilities.
anti_patterns.recommendation: Use parameterized queries or the query builder.

anti_patterns.name: avoid_ambiguous_function_names
anti_patterns.reason: Generic function names make code harder to understand and maintain.
anti_patterns.recommendation: Use descriptive names that indicate what the function actually does.

anti_patterns.name: no_empty_catch_blocks
anti_patterns.reason: Empty catch blocks silently swallow errors, making debugging difficult.
anti_patterns.recommendation: At minimum, log the error before re-raising or handling.

anti_patterns.name: prefer_pattern_matching_over_if
anti_patterns.reason: Pattern matching is more idiomatic and safer than type checking with if.
anti_patterns.recommendation: Use case/cond or pattern matching instead.

anti_patterns.name: no_direct_gen_server_call_in_hot_path
anti_patterns.reason: Synchronous GenServer calls in hot paths can cause performance bottlenecks.
anti_patterns.recommendation: Consider using cast, handle_info, or async_request.

anti_patterns.name: avoid_large_functions
anti_patterns.reason: Functions longer than 50 lines are difficult to test, understand, and maintain.
anti_patterns.recommendation: Break down into smaller, focused functions.

anti_patterns.name: no_debug_prints_in_production
anti_patterns.reason: Debug print statements should not be committed to production code.
anti_patterns.recommendation: Use Logger.debug/1 for structured logging that can be filtered.

anti_patterns.name: prefer_struct_over_map_for_known_shape
anti_patterns.reason: For known data shapes, structs provide compile-time guarantees and better performance.
anti_patterns.recommendation: Define a struct with defstruct instead of using maps.
